'''Tony Fanchi''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2001 Greeley tournament]] on 1 December 2001 with Senate Naboo drains, according to David Jones's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3144">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-04-greeley-co-12-1-revised-long-timed3144/ greeley-co-12-1-revised-long-time], DeckTech (David "DavCJ" Jones, 4 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-04-greeley-co-12-1-revised-long-timed3144/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
